## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Include affected backends and configuration keys.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `python -m pytest` and `python scripts/check_lint.py`.
- [ ] Added a focused regression test for changed behavior, where applicable.
- [ ] For scheduler, storage, docking, or ML changes, described which real environments were tested.
- [ ] Explained any remaining limitations or changes to the known-issue baseline.

Review guidance and local commands: [CI and code review](../docs/development/ci-and-review.md).
